Cost predictors
Visit type is only used for predicting the total unit cost. Fixed costs are assumed not to vary by type.
Total number of outpatient visits per year at facility
Other facilities are those without beds, such as health posts, dispensaries and community health units
Privately owned includes for-profits and non-profits
These covariates improve predictive performance but may not be readily available in all cases
Local price of building space per square meter
Average daily TB outpatient visits per FTE
*where local wage data, drug and supply prices are available, the variable cost components of a visit (clinical staff time, drug and supply costs) can be added to the predicted average fixed cost of a visit
